purpose: Prove a Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite User Data Chunk writer for one-frame compressed RGBA cel projects without claiming arbitrary editor project coverage or live external editor validation.

external_anchors.used_for: ASE header, frame header, Layer Chunk 0x2004, Cel Chunk 0x2005, and User Data Chunk 0x2020 layout.
LibreSprite remains a compatibility boundary; no GPL editor code is embedded.

limitations: Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite User Data writer covers one layer, one frame, one compressed RGBA cel, and one User Data text chunk.
Live external editor rewrite validation is not verified by this lab.
Full editor-native tags, timelines, tilemaps, linked cels, and arbitrary chunk coverage remain separate; palette/slice semantics are covered by a later Stage 0 lab.
